title: JBT Marel Industrial air frying solution
summary: Nearly every household seems to own an air fryer these days. Consumers are increasingly looking for healthier food options while still expecting the golden appearance, crispy bite, and satisfying taste traditionally associated with fried foods. For food producers, this raises an important question: how do you deliver healthier, crispy, and succulent snack foods on an industrial scale without compromising on quality, consistency, or throughput?
body_markdown:
##### Check weighing


The[M-Weigher Process Check](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/m-weigher-process-check/) monitors unpacked air-fried products to help ensure they meet target weight specifications. By providing feedback to upstream and downstream equipment, it helps improve weight accuracy, reduce rejects, manage giveaway, and minimize manual rework before products reach the packing stage.


##### Tray sealing


Our[Proseal tray sealing systems](https://jbtmarel.com/en/prepared-foods/battered-and-breaded-products/tray-sealing/) carefully package air-fried products, helping maintain seal integrity, product protection, and freshness. Integrated with weighing, loading, and automation systems, these solutions provide reliable, high-performance packaging lines for a wide range of convenience foods.


##### Weigh price labeling


Our[intelligent weigh price labeling systems](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/nexa/) deliver accurate, high-speed labeling with low running costs. Supporting multiple label formats across a wide range of pack types, the systems can handle up to 160 packs per minute while ensuring precise alignment and consistent label placement. Long-life print heads further support operational efficiency and reduced maintenance costs.


##### Case packing


Our[Proseal Case Packer](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/case-packing-machinery/) automates the transfer of packs into cases using high-speed 2D delta robotics. It supports multiple case formats while maintaining product quality and throughput. Quick-release tooling enables fast changeovers, while the ProMotion™ system ensures smooth and continuous operation.
